comments.author: @ElliWarkentin
comments.text: Wow, such amazing waters—I'd never heard of Bermuda before.

replies.author: @PrimeTravel2
replies.text: Thank you, the water around Bermuda really is something special. The island sits alone in the middle of the Atlantic, which is a big part of why so few people ever hear about it. Was there a moment in the video that surprised you the most?
